binding_guards: Bind conditions to the actual names plus their established ordinary-word reasons. Bind target to its actual stated target/label. Preserve the reason code separately in data; do not render raw enum codes.

Use existing ordinary explanations for other real reason codes. If none exists, say 'the returned result could not be used for this target' and retain the exact code/cause in data; do not invent a cause or user action.

Render one selected next-step sentence only when its existing predicate identifies a supported writer and a useful input. none_established adds nothing. No promise that one answer necessarily unlocks the full joint.

give_goal_current_level asks for a genuine current value only where that is the actual supported input. For a launch-forecast starting-rate selection use019's scoped ask and actual supported source/card route; do not relabel a future assumption as current observation.

rerun_analysis is true only where a fresh request is established to test the saved targets. A stale Run is a supported case; a current systematic mismatch is not automatically repaired by repeating it. Retain019's system-repair limitation.
Do not invent new units/fields absent from WithholdNextStepRef. Existing cards/source show the quantity units and reference. Do not substitute a size_link action for confirming a cost identity.
Do not use text matching to say a retained condition is included/excluded or dedupe it. Retained-unbound wording claims neither.

e928's capLine600 can truncate a long reason/action list. Do not assert verbatim retention after silently slicing bound conditions or promise an action that was cut off. Keep full per-condition state in the existing source/detail carrier; if current carriers cannot do so, retain the limit explicitly. This is not a request to hold the ordinary marketing cases for a new reader.
